SideSpeed 0.8.2 adds a language setting, makes the Companion clearer about TVs that are waiting for you, and keeps the TV's focus where you expect it.

## What's new
- **Language setting.** On the TV, **About** has a **Language** row. In the Companion it is in **Settings**. Choose **Same as device** or a language. A language ships once at least 70% of it is translated; if one you picked isn't complete in a version, the app says so and shows English. To help translate, see [docs/TRANSLATING.md](https://github.com/DevJardins/SideSpeed/blob/main/docs/TRANSLATING.md).
- **Confirm a TV you added before.** A TV you added before 0.8.1's identity check now waits until you press **Confirm** on the Companion's Home. The Companion checks it is the same TV, then leaves its secret on it. Until then it sends that TV nothing in the background.
- **"Waiting for you" in orange.** A TV that waits for you to confirm it, pair it or allow the older connection now has an orange border and says "Waiting for you". Before, it looked like a TV that could not be reached.
- **A stronger red.** A TV that can't be reached now shows a clear red, so it never looks calmer than one that is waiting for you.
- **Back on Android goes up one screen** in the Companion: Add and Settings go back to Home, About goes back to Settings. On Home, Back leaves the app as before.
- **TV focus.** Extras always shows the focus ring when it opens. Back from Extras lands on its **Open** button, and Back from History lands on **History**.
- **Screen readers.** The Companion's settings and back buttons now have names.

## Languages
This release is in English only. No translation has reached 70% yet.

**After updating:** start the helper again (on Google TV, open SideSpeed; on Fire TV, use the Companion).

## Downloads
**On the TV:** open the Downloader app and enter code **3503400**, or go to `sidespeed.app/tv`. Both always get the latest SideSpeed APK.

**Companion:** open `sidespeed.app/phone` on your phone, or see [sidespeed.app](https://sidespeed.app) for the desktop installers.

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `SideSpeed-0.8.2.apk` (also as `SideSpeed.apk`) | The TV app (Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV with Fire OS) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.8.2.apk` (also as `SideSpeed-Companion.apk`) | The companion for Android phones |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.8.2-macos-arm64.dmg` | The companion for macOS (Apple silicon) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.8.2-windows-x64.msi` | The companion for Windows |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.8.2-linux-amd64.deb` / `-x86_64.rpm` | The companion for Linux |
